confound_control: M1, M2 and M5 are recomputed on the intersection of individuals eligible under all nine definitions per cell; the rule uses the intersection version when it has at least 30 individuals in every cell, otherwise COMPARISON_CONFOUNDED and only the pass list is reported

metrics.M1: Fisher-z pooled R over the four cells (weights n-3, correlation clipped at 0.99); SE1 is the SD over bootstrap draws of the pooled value
metrics.M2: split-covariance signal share: cov(half1, half2) / var(individual means); descriptive only
metrics.M3: share of individuals whose match-cluster bootstrap 95% interval of the raw mean residual excludes the pooled cell mean; descriptive only
metrics.M4: median over individuals of pressure-ball counts, pooled over the four cells
metrics.M5: median over 1000 match-cluster resamples of the Spearman correlation between the resample ordering and the full-window ordering, per cell, then medianed over cells
metrics.M6: control reliability of a non-pressure ball sample matched on balls per individual; descriptive only, never a selection input
metrics.R: odd/even split-half Spearman-Brown reliability of definition d in cell c, primary stream, PRE_TEST, at least 6 pressure balls per half, at least 10 individuals; match-cluster bootstrap with 1000 draws; lo is the 2.5th percentile of the draws

multiplicity: nine candidates examined, no correction applied; any top group is PROVISIONAL and does not replace any|q0.75
provisional_definition_unchanged: any|q0.75 stays the provisional definition regardless of outcome; a change needs a user decision
rule: PASS(d) iff R(d,c) is estimable in all four cells and lo(d,c) > 0 in at least three cells. TOP(d) iff PASS(d) and M1(d) >= max M1 over passing definitions minus SE1 of the best. Order inside TOP: M4 descending, then M5 descending, then id ascending. The output is a pass list and a top group, not a selection.

split_half.aggregation: Fisher z with weights n-3, correlation clipped at 0.99
split_half.label: IN_SAMPLE_DIAGNOSTIC_TRAIN_VALIDATION
split_half.spearman_brown: 2r/(1+r), reported unclipped; a negative r gives a negative value

stability_outcomes: if the TOP set on TRAIN only differs from the PRE_TEST TOP set the report states DEFINITION_ORDER_NOT_STABLE and names no top group
unit: definition x (format, role) cell; the selection rule uses the primary stream of each role only (batter runs, bowler charged runs); other streams are descriptive

flag_definitions.H-A_null: E7 bootstrap 95% interval contains 0 and the E6 share of draws with a positive match-cluster estimate is below positive_draw_share_min
flag_definitions.H-A_power: detectability simulation share of positive estimates at tau2/sigma2 = power_ratio is at least power_min
flag_definitions.H-B(i): mean(sigma2/n_eff_kish) / mean(sigma2/n_i), divided by the mean balls per match, lies in [kish_ratio_to_balls_per_match_lo, ..._hi]
flag_definitions.H-B(ii): the sign of the between variance differs between the Kish basis (E1) and the match-cluster basis (E1c)
flag_definitions.H-B(iii): residual-variance ratio of the lowest versus highest tercile of ball counts is above tercile_variance_ratio_hi or below tercile_variance_ratio_lo
flag_definitions.H-B(iv): ICC of ball residuals within match or within individual-match cluster above icc_min, or Pearson dispersion of the moment fit above pearson_dispersion_min
flag_definitions.H-B_overall: at least min_supported_of_hb_i_to_iv of H-B(i) to H-B(iv) supported, including H-B(ii)
flag_definitions.H-C: E7 or E6 lower bound > 0 and the required-sample projection for R = 0.5 is finite and larger than the observed median ball count

identification_rule.identified_positive: E7 split-covariance bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 and E1c match-cluster moment estimate positive in at least 90% of E6 bootstrap draws
identification_rule.not_identified: E7 interval contains 0 and the E6 share of positive draws is below 90%

variance_floor.sparse_context: fewer than 8 TRAIN individuals or fewer than 10 per half is NOT_ESTIMABLE with a reason
verdict_table_in_order: H-A_null and H-A_power and not H-B_overall

window: PRE_TEST (TRAIN + VALIDATION); repeated on TRAIN only as a stability check
